name: week
title: Collections week
subtitle: Internal working report; fictional demo until you import your records.

sections.title: Loans due
sections.sql: select code,name,borrower,due_on,days_overdue from v_loans where status='active' and due_on<=current_date+30 order by due_on

sections.title: Actions
sections.sql: select * from v_attention order by rule,code

sections.title: Condition and loan conflicts
sections.sql: select * from v_exhibition_readiness order by exhibition,code

sections.title: Locations and care
sections.sql: select code,name,location,normal_location,grade,next_review,inventory_checked_on from v_catalogue order by code
